params.comment: The Pages tab reads this repo's public page, the Quality page, at its Pages URL. origin is the production URL; site_dir stays empty because the build writes quality/dist after the readings.

goal_source: Off: the collector reads a src folder of built-site source (CSS, Astro, HTML) and finds none. The repo's one hand-written page, site/map.html, sits outside it and is not measured. Its params stay, because the other Design metrics read them. Reversal: delete drop when a src folder is added, or when the collector can read site/.

params.comment: The usability metrics read the site from this entry: origin and site_dir match design.raw_hex. key_pages are the two pages the repo ships, written relative to origin because the site lives under /compute-crafter/ and a leading slash would leave it.
platform pages reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API.
